title: LaTeX Table OS Style Parity
summary: Added `semio-table.sty` LaTeX package mirroring OS React `Table` styling: hairline horizontal row dividers, window-toned header row (`semio-chrome-window`, 9× spacing height, bold), body rows at 7× spacing height, token-driven colors/strokes/fonts. Registered in `semio.cls`. Migrated `zwischenbericht.content.tex` workpackages table from bare `tabular` to `SemioTableBegin`/`SemioTableHeaderRow`/`SemioTableRow`/`SemioTableEnd`. All 12 print template PDFs compile.
